I’ve been iterating on performance benchmarks for the MythosMini model, focusing on the flexible attention implementation versus the standard SDPA path. The recent profiling runs showed that the flex backward pass is a significant portion of the step time (around 33%). When I switched to a detached-bias variant, I observed a notable speedup to 1.28 Mtok/s, which is substantially better than the previous measurements (flex ~1.03 Mtok/s, sdpa-bias ~0.95 Mtok/s). This suggests that detaching the bias tensor before the backward pass reduces the overhead, likely because it avoids unnecessary gradient tracking for the bias term.

To verify that this improvement is robust, I need to integrate the detaching logic directly into the model’s codebase. The relevant class is `SparseSelection` in `src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py`. Currently it only stores the tensors `selected`, `biased`, `index_queries`, `index_keys`, and `gate`. There is no method to produce a detached version of the selection, which is what I manually did in the benchmark script by calling `.biased.detach()`.

I should add a small utility method `detached(self) -> "SparseSelection"` that returns a new `SparseSelection` instance where the `biased` tensor is detached (if it exists), while preserving the other fields unchanged. This will allow the model to optionally use a detached bias without having to duplicate code in each benchmark. Adding the method directly to the dataclass keeps the API clean and makes the change reusable.

I need to edit the file `src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py`. The edit should locate the definition of `SparseSelection` (the block starting with `@dataclass
class SparseSelection:`) and insert the new `detached` method after the existing fields. I’ll use the Edit tool with `replace_all: false` so that only this specific block is modified, preserving the rest of the file. The old string is the exact class header and field definitions, and the new string will be the same plus the added method definition.

Thus, the appropriate next action is to apply this edit.Edit input={"replace_all": false, "file_path": "/home/lane/MythosMini/src/mythosmini/model/transformer.py", "old_string": "@dataclass
class SparseSelection:
    selected: Tensor | None
    biased: Tensor | None
    index_queries: Tensor
    index_keys: Tensor
    gate: Tensor", "new_string": "@dataclass
class SparseSelection:
    selected: Tensor | None
    biased: Tensor | None
    index_queries: Tensor
    index_keys: Tensor
    gate: Tensor

    def detached(self) -> "SparseSelection":
        frozen = self.biased.detach() if self.biased is not None else None
        return SparseSelection(
            self.selected, frozen, self.index_queries, self.index_keys, self.gate
        )"}
